shuffled_predicate_to_part_baseline.interpretation_limit: Both nulls are descriptive only. The second preserves route-group counts across predicate mappings, not relation-frequency weighted counts. Group point counts and visibility are controlled only in the complete two-point-group comparison.

metric_protocol.primary: fractional credit: 1/k when the routed group is in k tied nearest groups; 0 otherwise
metric_protocol.secondary_inclusive: binary credit if routed group is among all tied minima
metric_protocol.secondary_unique: binary credit only if routed group is the unique nearest group
metric_protocol.rank: competition rank 1 + number of strictly closer available groups; tied minima all rank one
metric_protocol.prediction_availability: keypoints_scores >= fixed threshold; keypoints third dimension retains visibility
metric_protocol.random_null: same fractional/inclusive/unique definitions and same eligible relations as observed
metric_protocol.verified_on_actual_relations: group order invariant; score bounds; nearest credits sum to one; rank-one equals inclusive minimum; aggregate/per-predicate scores agree

interpretation: Descriptive keypoint-to-box proximity proxies only; COCO labels are an oracle-like geometry reference and model outputs are predictions. Neither is contact truth, an independent human audit, or a validated relation verifier.
